name: Ra's al Ghul
summary: A centuries-old villain who wants Batman as his heir. Ra's al Ghul, the Demon's Head, leads a league of assassins and keeps cheating death in the Lazarus Pits.
origin: Ra's al Ghul is the rare villain who respects Batman and wants him as a son-in-law, which makes him uniquely unsettling. Editor Julius Schwartz came up with the name, and Dennis O'Neil and Neal Adams brought him to life in Batman #232 in 1971, in the story 'Daughter of the Demon'. Centuries old thanks to the Lazarus Pits, he leads a global network of assassins and believes the Earth can only be saved by wiping out most of humanity. He is a brilliant strategist, a master swordsman and martial artist, and a schemer who plans in centuries. His daughter Talia's love for Batman, and their son Damian, keep the feud a family affair.
powers: Long life and healing from the Lazarus Pits

storyline.title: The Demon's Head
storyline.beat: Denny O'Neil and Neal Adams introduce Ra's al Ghul, the centuries-old leader of a league of assassins who wants Batman to marry his daughter Talia and inherit his empire.

storyline.title: An heir
storyline.beat: Batman and Talia's relationship results in a child, later developed as Damian Wayne.

storyline.title: Origin
storyline.beat: A graphic novel tells how Ra's began, centuries ago, as a physician who discovered the Lazarus Pit.

storyline.title: Plague
storyline.beat: Ra's unleashes a deadly virus on Gotham as part of his plan to cull humanity, and Batman tracks him across the world.

storyline.title: A new body
storyline.beat: After his death, Ra's tries to return by taking over the body of his grandson Damian.

gossip.text: His name means the Demon's Head in Arabic.
He stays alive by bathing in Lazarus Pits, which heal and restore him but can drive him mad.
He is the grandfather of Damian Wayne, Batman's son.
Liam Neeson played him in Batman Begins (2005), which hid the character behind another name until a late twist.

theme.tagline: Centuries old and still recruiting a son-in-law.

timeline.title: The Demon's Head
timeline.note: Batman #232 introduces Ra's, a centuries-old eco-fanatic who wants Batman as his heir.

timeline.title: The Lazarus Pit
timeline.note: Batman #243 reveals the chemical pits that keep Ra's alive for centuries.

timeline.title: The Demon's Quest
timeline.note: Batman: The Animated Series adapts his debut as a two-part, globe-trotting adventure.

timeline.title: Death and the Maidens
timeline.note: Ra's finally dies, with his long-lost daughter Nyssa's revenge plot at the story's heart.

timeline.title: Batman Begins
timeline.note: Liam Neeson plays Ra's as Bruce's mentor-turned-enemy in Christopher Nolan's reboot.

timeline.title: A grandson
timeline.note: Grant Morrison introduces Damian Wayne, Ra's grandson by Talia and Bruce.

timeline.title: Resurrection
timeline.note: The Resurrection of Ra's al Ghul crossover brings the Demon's Head back in a stolen body.
